lineage.description: District-level population and land statistics extracted from Nepal's 2011 census as published in the Environment Statistics of Nepal 2013 report by the Central Bureau of Statistics. Data includes geographical area, household counts, population figures, and derived metrics (population density and population-land ratio) aggregated at the district administrative level.
